aka.zh: 退伍军人纪念公路（穆斯乔至艾伯特王子城）
加美公路（艾伯特王子城至拉朗格）

tagline.en: Saskatchewan from bottom to top: from the Montana border across the wheat country to Prince Albert, then into the forest to La Ronge
tagline.zh: 从南到北纵贯萨斯喀彻温：自蒙大拿边境穿过麦田到艾伯特王子城，再进入森林直抵拉朗格

start.en: The West Poplar River border crossing with Montana, south of Assiniboia
start.zh: 阿西尼博亚以南、与蒙大拿相接的西波普勒河口岸

end.en: La Ronge, on Lac la Ronge at the edge of the Canadian Shield
end.zh: 加拿大地盾边缘、拉朗格湖畔的拉朗格

en: Highway 2 runs north through the middle of Saskatchewan for nearly 800 km. Its southern half crosses open grain and ranching country from the Montana border through Assiniboia and Moose Jaw, then on through the parkland past Watrous and Wakaw to Prince Albert on the North Saskatchewan River.

North of Prince Albert it enters the boreal forest, passing Prince Albert National Park and Montreal Lake, and ends at La Ronge on the edge of the Canadian Shield. It is the main road link between the southern cities and the northern half of the province.
At Chamberlain it shares a short stretch of road with Highway 11, and the two run in opposite signed directions, a so-called wrong-way concurrency.
zh: 2 号公路纵贯萨斯喀彻温中部，向北延伸近 800 公里。其南半段自蒙大拿边境经阿西尼博亚与穆斯乔，穿过开阔的谷物与牧场地带，再经瓦特勒斯与瓦考穿过白杨林草原，到达北萨斯喀彻温河畔的艾伯特王子城。
艾伯特王子城以北，它进入北方森林，经过艾伯特王子国家公园与蒙特利尔湖，止于加拿大地盾边缘的拉朗格。它是南部城市与该省北半部之间的主要公路联系。
它在张伯伦与 11 号公路共线一小段，两者的标示方向相反，即所谓“逆向共线”。

en: The road north of Prince Albert into the forest reached La Ronge in 1947, according to a University of Saskatchewan thesis, while the Encyclopedia of Saskatchewan gives 1947–48 and a provincial land-use plan 1948. In the late 1960s it was rerouted west of Montreal Lake and paved, and the community of Molanosa on the old line moved to Weyakwin on the new one.

In the south, the river at St. Louis was crossed by ferry until a railway bridge was built in 1912; road lanes were added to it in 1928. The highway south of Chamberlain to Moose Jaw was completed in 1953. On 10 November 2005 the province unveiled signs naming the section from Moose Jaw to Prince Albert the Veterans Memorial Highway. The Prince Albert–La Ronge section is also signed as part of the CanAm Highway.

In October 2014 a new bridge over the South Saskatchewan River at St. Louis opened 1.6 km east of the century-old bridge it replaced. The province said it completed a 683 km primary-weight corridor from Assiniboia to La Ronge. In 2026 work began on twinning about 6 km north of Prince Albert.
zh: 艾伯特王子城以北深入森林的道路，据萨斯喀彻温大学的一篇学位论文，于 1947 年通到拉朗格；《萨斯喀彻温百科全书》作 1947—1948 年，一份省级土地利用规划则作 1948 年。20 世纪 60 年代末，它改线至蒙特利尔湖以西并铺装，旧线上的莫拉诺萨社区也随之迁往新线上的韦亚昆。
在南段，圣路易斯的河道一直靠渡轮通行，直到 1912 年建成一座铁路桥；1928 年桥上增设了车行道。张伯伦以南至穆斯乔的路段于 1953 年完工。2005 年 11 月 10 日，该省揭开路牌，将穆斯乔至艾伯特王子城段命名为“退伍军人纪念公路”。艾伯特王子城至拉朗格段同时标为“加美公路”的一部分。
2014 年 10 月，圣路易斯的南萨斯喀彻温河新桥通车，位于被替换的百年老桥以东 1.6 公里。该省表示，新桥使阿西尼博亚至拉朗格之间 683 公里的一级载重走廊全线贯通。2026 年，艾伯特王子城以北约 6 公里的双幅加宽工程开工。

value.en: 786.5 km from the province's official highway data (October 2026); English Wikipedia gives 797.7 km.
value.zh: 据该省官方公路数据（2026 年 10 月）为 786.5 公里；英文维基百科作 797.7 公里。

figures.source: Saskatchewan Ministry of Highways, HIGHWAY_OFFICIAL dataset, 18 October 2026 (computed); English Wikipedia, Saskatchewan Highway 2

value.en: No route-wide figure. St. Louis bridge project $60 million (2014), of which $25 million for the bridge and $35 million for the approach roads; twinning north of Prince Albert $12.9 million (2026).
value.zh: 无全线数字。圣路易斯大桥项目 6,000 万加元（2014 年），其中桥梁 2,500 万加元、引道 3,500 万加元；艾伯特王子城以北双幅加宽 1,290 万加元（2026 年）。

figures.source: CBC News, October 2014; Government of Saskatchewan news release, 2026

value.en: The province, through the Ministry of Highways. The 2026 twinning north of Prince Albert is shared equally between Canada and Saskatchewan.
value.zh: 省政府，经由公路厅。2026 年艾伯特王子城以北的双幅加宽工程由联邦与萨斯喀彻温省各出资一半。

figures.source: Government of Saskatchewan news releases, 24 October 2014 and 2026

value.en: Completed in 1947 (University of Saskatchewan thesis), 1947–48 (Encyclopedia of Saskatchewan) or 1948 (provincial land-use plan).
value.zh: 完工年份：1947 年（萨斯喀彻温大学学位论文）、1947—1948 年（《萨斯喀彻温百科全书》）或 1948 年（省级土地利用规划）。

figures.source: Encyclopedia of Saskatchewan; University of Saskatchewan thesis; Government of Saskatchewan land-use plan

timeline.en: Road lanes are added to the 1912 railway bridge over the South Saskatchewan at St. Louis.
timeline.zh: 圣路易斯跨南萨斯喀彻温河的 1912 年铁路桥增设车行道。

timeline.en: The road from Prince Albert reaches La Ronge (1948 in some sources).
timeline.zh: 自艾伯特王子城出发的道路通到拉朗格（部分资料作 1948 年）。

timeline.en: The section from Chamberlain south to Moose Jaw is completed.
timeline.zh: 张伯伦以南至穆斯乔段完工。

timeline.en: Signs naming Moose Jaw–Prince Albert the Veterans Memorial Highway are unveiled on 10 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 10 日，穆斯乔至艾伯特王子城段“退伍军人纪念公路”路牌揭幕。

timeline.en: The new St. Louis bridge opens in October, completing a primary-weight corridor from Assiniboia to La Ronge.
timeline.zh: 10 月，圣路易斯新桥通车，阿西尼博亚至拉朗格的一级载重走廊贯通。

timeline.en: Twinning of about 6 km north of Prince Albert begins, jointly funded by Canada and Saskatchewan.
timeline.zh: 艾伯特王子城以北约 6 公里的双幅加宽工程开工，由联邦与萨斯喀彻温省共同出资。
